## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you are proposing. What should it do, in one or two sentences?

## Motivation / use case

Describe the problem you are trying to solve or the situation where this feature would help. Who is affected, and what do you have to do today without it?

## Proposed solution (optional)

If you already have an idea for how this could work, describe it here. Keep it open ended; the implementation approach is up to maintainers.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any workarounds or alternative approaches you have tried or considered, and why they did not fully solve the problem.

## Additional context

Add anything else that helps explain the request, such as examples, screenshots, links, or environment details.
